title: The direct-image counit remains nonzero after affine base change
statement: Let k be a field and f:X -> Spec k a flat proper morphism locally of finite presentation, and assume the module categories of X_T admit injective resolutions for all k-schemes T [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let L be a Picard class [def-pc-picard-functor] on X_T with IsInvertibleDirectImage f T L, the condition defining F [def-pc-f-subfunctor]. Suppose V is an affine open of T and s is a free generator of fT_*L on V. For a morphism q:T0 -> T over k with T0 affine, nontrivial ring of global functions and image contained in V, the pullback along baseChangeMap f q [def-pc-base-change] of the ordinary pullback/pushforward adjunction counit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] at the skeleton representative of L is nonzero.

proof.text: The existing proof first shows pullbackSection_baseChangeMap_ne_zero: choose a finite trivializing affine cover above V. Its Cech terms are flat over A = Gamma(T,V), affine intersections being affine by separatedness. Base change gives the termwise tensor complex; stability of IsInvertibleDirectImage gives exactness in degree one after any base change. Apply this also to square-zero extensions A plus N. The flat equalizer criterion then makes tensor of the degree-zero kernel inject into the tensor of the degree-zero Cech term. A free generator tensored with 1 is nonzero over the nontrivial target ring, hence its pulled-back section is nonzero. The right triangle identity says that applying the original counit to the unit image of s gives s. Pullback of sections commutes with applying module morphisms. Consequently a zero pulled-back counit would annihilate the nonzero pulled-back section, a contradiction. The nontriviality hypothesis correctly excludes an empty affine source. This is a description of the already complete source proof, not a new elementary Cech theorem to be proved.

theorem pullback_baseChangeMap_map_counit_ne_zero
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), HasInjectiveResolutions (Limits.pullback f T.hom).Modules] {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    {L : (Limits.pullback f T.hom).Pic} (hL : IsInvertibleDirectImage f T L)
    {V : T.left.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    {s : Γ((pushforward (Limits.pullback.snd f T.hom)).obj ((fromSkeleton _).obj L.val), V)}
    (hs : IsFreeGenerator s) {T₀ : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T₀ ⟶ T) [IsAffine T₀.left]
    [Nontrivial Γ(T₀.left, ⊤)] (hq : ⊤ ≤ q.left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    (Modules.pullback (baseChangeMap f q)).map
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Limits.pullback.snd f T.hom)).counit.app
        ((fromSkeleton _).obj L.val)) ≠ 0
